title: 第十三章 钟山之子第十四章 流沙噬日
lines: 第十三章：钟山之子
悬圃的“葌草”沼泽，并不像名字听起来那么诗意。
那是一片死寂的银色荒原。地面不是泥土，而是由无数细密的、如同金属丝线般的植物根系编织而成的巨大地毯。那些所谓的“葌草”，其实是一种高约半米、通体银白的禾本科植物，叶片边缘锋利如刀，在高原的强风中发出类似竖琴拨弦的“铮铮”声，听起来竟有几分凄凉。
“这哪是什么仙草，这是钢丝网。”黄海涛拄着一根树枝当拐杖，腿伤虽然被西王母的“神力”压制，但每走一步依然牵扯着神经，疼得他龇牙咧嘴，“看这根系密度，这下面绝对是空的。”
“下面是蓄水层。”李元茜蹲下身，用放大镜观察那些银色的草叶，“叶片表面有纳米级的沟壑结构，这是用来收集雾气的。悬圃气候干燥，它们靠这个生存。但……”
她话音未落，手中的探测器突然发出刺耳的警报。
“地下有金属反应！深度……十五米左右。”
两人对视一眼，默契地停下脚步。黄海涛从包里掏出一把工兵铲，李元茜则从急救包里摸出两把手术刀——这是她们现在能找到的最锋利的东西。
“陈宇就在附近。”黄海涛压低声音，指向沼泽深处，“那边的草被踩倒了一片。”
果然，在一片茂密的葌草丛中，有一条凌乱的、深陷进根系的足迹通向深处。足迹很新鲜，旁边的草叶还在微微颤动。
两人小心翼翼地循着足迹前进。走了大约一百米，眼前的景象豁然开朗。
沼泽中央，出现了一个巨大的、圆形的空洞。空洞边缘的葌草被粗暴地连根拔起，扔在一旁。而在空洞中央，一个人正跪在地上，双手疯狂地挖掘着。
是陈宇。
但他已经不是他们记忆中那个意气风发的科考队长了。
他的头发胡子拉碴，乱得像鸟窝，身上的冲锋衣破烂不堪，多处露出缝合着奇怪符文的皮补丁。最诡异的是他的眼睛——那是一双布满血丝、瞳孔却呈现出诡异竖瞳的眼睛，死死盯着地下的某个点，嘴里念念有词。
“……坐标……锁定……葌草的根……就是钥匙……开门……回家……”
他一边喃喃自语，一边用一把造型奇特的、像是改装过的地质钻机，疯狂地钻探着地下。钻机发出刺耳的摩擦声，火星四溅。
“陈宇！”李元茜忍不住喊出声。
陈宇猛地回头。那双竖瞳在看到两人的瞬间，闪过一丝短暂的清明，随即又被狂热吞噬。
“元茜？黄海涛？”他咧嘴一笑，露出一口被烟草熏黄的牙齿，“你们也来了？太好了！我找到了！我找到了回家的路！”
他指着脚下那个已经被钻出直径两米大坑的洞口。
“这下面，是‘钟山’的地基！”陈宇的声音因激动而颤抖，“《西山经》里说，‘钟山，其子曰鼓，其状如人面而龙身。’我懂了！那不是神话！那是一个地底文明的遗迹！这葌草的根系，就是连接地表和地心的生物天线！只要切断它，就能打开通道！”
“你在干什么！”黄海涛冲过去，试图夺下他的钻机，“你知不知道你在做什么？西王母说这是诱饵！”
“诱饵？”陈宇像是听到了天大的笑话，猛地推开黄海涛，“她是怕我们抢走‘钥匙’！你们看！”
他指着洞口深处。借着钻机头灯的光，两人看到，在地下十五米左右的深处，确实有一层巨大的、金属质感的穹顶。而在穹顶表面，密密麻麻地生长着无数根粗壮的、银白色的根系——正是那些葌草的主根。这些根系像血管一样深深扎进金属穹顶的缝隙里，甚至有一些根系已经穿透了穹顶，垂吊在下面的黑暗中。
“那是……生物接口？”李元茜倒吸一口凉气。
“没错！”陈宇狂笑，“这是史前文明留下的‘电梯’！这葌草就是电梯缆绳！只要我把这些根切断，下面的‘电梯’就会启动，带我们去地表，去我们的时代！”
他举起钻机，对准一根最粗的根系，就要按下开关。
“别动！”黄海涛大吼一声，扑过去想阻止他。
但晚了。
钻机启动，高速旋转的钻头狠狠切向那根银白色的根系。
就在钻头接触根系的瞬间，异变突生。
那根被切断的根系并没有流出汁液，而是像高压电线一样，爆出一团刺眼的白色电弧！

Chapter Thirteen: Son of Zhongshan
1.
Xuanpu's "Tiger Grass" swamp is not as poetic as its name sounds.
It was a dead silver wasteland. The ground is not soil, but a huge carpet woven by countless fine plant roots that look like metal threads. Those so-called "tamagrass" are actually a kind of silver-white grass plant about half a meter tall. The edges of the leaves are as sharp as knives. In the strong wind on the plateau, they make a "clanging" sound similar to the plucking of harp strings, which sounds a bit desolate.
"What kind of fairy grass is this? This is a steel wire mesh." Huang Haitao used a branch as a crutch. Although his leg injury was suppressed by the "divine power" of the Queen Mother of the West, his nerves were still involved with every step he took. He grinned in pain. "Look at the density of the root system, there is definitely nothing down here."
"There is an aquifer below." Li Yuanqian squatted down and used a magnifying glass to observe the silver grass blades. "There are nano-scale ravine structures on the surface of the blades, which are used to collect fog. The climate of the hanging garden is dry, and they rely on this to survive. But..."
Before she finished speaking, the detector in her hand suddenly sounded a piercing alarm.
"There is a metal reaction underground! The depth is...about fifteen meters."
The two looked at each other and stopped in silent agreement. Huang Haitao took out an engineering shovel from his bag, and Li Yuanqian took out two scalpels from the first aid bag—the sharpest things they could find now.
"Chen Yu is nearby." Huang Haitao lowered his voice and pointed to the depths of the swamp, "The grass over there has been trampled down."
Sure enough, in a dense patch of grass, there was a messy, deep-rooted trail leading to the depths. The footprints were fresh, and the grass blades beside them were still trembling slightly.
The two of them followed the footsteps carefully. After walking about a hundred meters, the scene in front of me suddenly became clear.
In the center of the swamp, a huge, circular hole appeared. The grass growing at the edge of the hollow was roughly uprooted and thrown aside. In the center of the hollow, a man was kneeling on the ground, digging frantically with his hands.
It's Chen Yu.
But he was no longer the high-spirited expedition captain they remembered.
His hair was unkempt and as messy as a bird's nest, and his jacket was in tatters, with leather patches stitched with strange runes exposed in many places. The weirdest thing was his eyes - they were a pair of bloodshot eyes with strange vertical pupils, staring at a certain point underground while muttering something.
"...Coordinates...lock...the root of the wormwood...is the key...open the door...go home..."
While muttering to himself, he used a strange-looking geological drill that seemed to have been modified to drill into the ground crazily. The drill made a harsh grinding sound and sparks flew everywhere.
"Chen Yu!" Li Yuanqian couldn't help shouting.
Chen Yu turned back sharply. The moment the pair of vertical pupils saw the two of them, a brief moment of clarity flashed through them, and then they were swallowed up by fanaticism.
"Yuan Qian? Huang Haitao?" He grinned, showing teeth yellowed by tobacco, "You are here too? Great! I found it! I found the way home!"
He pointed to the hole at his feet where a two-meter-diameter hole had been drilled.
"Underneath this is the foundation of 'Zhongshan'!" Chen Yu's voice trembled with excitement. "The "Western Mountain Sutra" says, 'Zhongshan, whose son is called Gu, is shaped like a human face and a dragon's body.' I understand! That is not a myth! It is the relic of an underground civilization! The root system of this grass is the biological antenna that connects the surface and the center of the earth! As long as it is cut off, the channel can be opened!"
"What are you doing!" Huang Haitao rushed over and tried to seize his drill. "Do you know what you are doing? The Queen Mother of the West said this is bait!"
"Bait?" Chen Yu seemed to have heard a big joke and pushed Huang Haitao away. "She is afraid that we will steal the 'key'! Look!"
He pointed deep into the cave entrance. By the light of the drill's headlight, the two saw that there was indeed a huge, metallic dome about fifteen meters underground. On the surface of the dome, there are countless thick, silvery-white roots growing densely—the main roots of those grasses. These roots penetrated deeply into the gaps in the metal dome like blood vessels, and some roots even penetrated the dome and hung in the darkness below.
"That's... a biological interface?" Li Yuanqian took a breath.
"That's right!" Chen Yu laughed wildly, "This is the 'elevator' left by prehistoric civilization! This grass is the elevator cable! As long as I cut off these roots, the 'elevator' below will start and take us to the surface, to our era!"
He raised the drill, pointed it at the thickest root system, and pressed the switch.
"Don't move!" Huang Haitao yelled and rushed over to stop him.
But it was too late.
Buzz—!
The drill started, and the high-speed rotating drill bit cut hard into the silver-white root system.
The moment the drill bit touched the root system, a sudden change occurred.
The severed root system did not flow out juice, but instead burst out with a dazzling white arc like a high-voltage wire!
